channel.title: Lesotho - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Lesotho, every source cited.

item.title: Lesotho Correctional Service promotions challenged in court
item.description: Assistant Superintendent Moji Zakea questions the legality of five promotions made in January.

item.title: Lesotho police risk allowance dispute continues
item.description: Officers have waited since 1994 for an increase from M100 to M1500 monthly.

item.title: Standard Bank plants 2000 trees in Mafeteng
item.description: The bank's Blue Roots programme aims to plant one million trees across Africa, with 54,000 planted previously in Mohale's Hoek.

item.title: WASCO begins Mafeteng drought relief plan
item.description: The water company will supply tanks, drill boreholes, and dredge Rasebale Dam to secure water.

item.title: Lesotho cricket team loses final match in Abuja
item.description: The national side finished fourth in the Africa Cricket Association regional qualifying tournament after a three-run defeat to Gambia.
